questions.q: Which of these is a renewable source of energy?
questions.why: Geothermal uses heat from the Earth, which is continually replenished.

options: energy demand is greater than a country can produce or afford
a gap between two power stations
a power cut lasting a day
questions.why: An energy gap exists when demand exceeds supply.

questions.q: Which is a disadvantage of hydroelectric power (HEP)?
options: it releases large amounts of CO₂ when generating
it can only be used at night
dams flood land and displace people
questions.why: Reservoirs behind dams flood valleys, homes and habitats.

questions.q: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of using solar panels to generate electricity.
questions.model: Advantage: no CO₂ emitted when generating, so it does not add to climate change. Disadvantage: only works when it is sunny, so needs back-up or costly batteries.
